sections.content: Use simple invitation forms such as ¿Quieres venir? and ¿Te gustaría venir? to invite someone. Positive responses can use Sí, claro, Me gustaría or Sí, quiero ir. Keep the invitation focused on the event, time or activity. In this lesson the main aim is making and accepting invitations naturally.

items.english: Do you want to come to the party?
Yes, of course. I want to go.
Would you like to come on Saturday?

sections.content: Use ya for something completed and todavía no for something that has not happened yet.
